name: ChuShi SMTC Manager
author: ChuShi
description: ChuShi SMTC Manager (ASCII-only build): deploys and supervises the full-power SMTC engine (chushi-smtc-engine.ps1 v4.0.0, embedded base64, SHA-256 verified read-back). The engine owns ONE complete Windows media session (media keys / overlay card / draggable progress) driven purely by truth pushed from the ChuShi Music API plugin. It NEVER reads NetEase's own SMTC session -- the NetEase SMTC switch is NOT required, ON or OFF. Kill-stale is image-guarded (powershell only), spawn failures back off honestly (20/40/80/160 s) and surface as a blocked flag. Zero playback state is produced here. Pair with the ChuShi Music API plugin (same port).
